idea: How to stop checking your phone at work
text:
You know that feeling when your phone is always in your hand [pause] and you can’t put it down [look at camera] even when you’re supposed to be working [smile].

Here’s the thing you can do to stop the urge to check your phone [confident] you can train your mind to focus elsewhere [pause] no more notifications [emphasis].

First close the app immediately [pause] second set a timer for 25 minutes [look at camera] third walk around the room [confident] to reset your focus [pause].

That’s the shift [pause] the moment you realize you don’t need the phone anymore [smile].
title: Stop Checking Your Phone at Work
